title: review: Fix: _merge_reviewed_one checks already_merged before the "branch head moved" path (no review of merged work after a hand merge); gate hold message distinguishes not-collected tests
spec:
Goal T-0503 hotfixes, the last daemon.py change in the chain. Base goal/T-0503 with S4b v6 (T-0550) merged. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only. Tests are unittest.TestCase methods.
Observed 2026-09-21: after the Planner merged T-0505 by hand (merge() rebased task/T-0505 onto goal/T-0503, head e96d692 -> 3b74ce7), daemon._merge_reviewed_one saw the worktree head differ from pipeline.reviewed_sha and opened a fresh security review T-0515 of already-merged work because the head-moved check runs before already_merged(t); the same happened for T-0506 (T-0521), T-0514 (T-0519), T-0517 (T-0527) and T-0508 (T-0533): five wasted sonnet reviews.
1. daemon._merge_reviewed_one: evaluate merged_into / already_merged(t) before the reviewed_sha/head-moved comparison; a merged task returns without opening reviews or notifying. Keep the void-approval behaviour for unmerged tasks whose head moved.
2. daemon.gate hold path (review T-0522 low finding): the resume_hint failure message for acceptance.missing_tests entries reads the entry's reason: "(missing: test not defined)" for a missing def, "(missing: test not collected by unittest, define it inside a TestCase)" for a not_collected entry (T-0517 added NotCollectedTest with .reason).
3. Tests: tests/test_daemon.py::test_merge_reviewed_skips_head_moved_review_for_merged_task (a done task with merged_into set and a worktree head that differs from pipeline.reviewed_sha gets no new review task and no notify), tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_hold_message_names_not_collected_tests. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_merge_reviewed_skips_head_moved_review_for_merged_task passes: a merged task whose head moved gets no new review task and no notification; unmerged tasks whose head moved still get the fresh review (existing tests stay green)
tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_hold_message_names_not_collected_tests passes: the gate's resume_hint names not-collected tests distinctly from undefined ones
full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 and the suite gains two tests
